name: Warther Hof
kurzbeschreibung: Warther Hof: family-run 4-star superior wellness hotel in Warth am Arlberg with restaurant, parlors, sun terrace and bar.
beschreibung:
The Warther Hof is a family-run 4-star superior wellness hotel in Warth am Arlberg, run by the Roiderer and Jäger families. It is located on Bregenzerwaldstraße 53 at just under 1,500 meters altitude at the highest point of the Arlberg, near the source of the Lech.

The hotel features several rustic parlors such as the Hochtannbergstube, the Wälderstube, the Walserstube and the Wintergarten, a sun terrace and a hotel bar. The kitchen serves Austrian dishes and international specialties made from fresh ingredients; the restaurant is also open to external guests.

According to the website, there is a breakfast buffet from 08:00 to 10:30, lunch from 11:30 to 13:45, a small afternoon menu until 17:00 and a 6-course dinner menu from 18:30 to 20:30; advance reservation is requested for breakfast and dinner.
